page.layout: One printed page of text in a single column, with a running head at the top and the page number at the top right; a fleuron band in the middle; a summary list below. Fragments of marginal text (left edge, from the neighbouring page) are not transcribed.

main_text.p: tum, si fit alias necessarium & omni alia ex parte debite conditionatum.
main_text.head: Prælectio Quarta. Continens Casus Quindecim.
SUMMARIUM.
main_text.l: 5, 6. Juramentum ejus qui est sub alterius potestate.
9. Juramentum an & quatenus obliget jurantis haeredes.

page.notes: The signature "F" appears at the foot left, below item 9. The fleuron band is decorative. Some letters in the summary are faint or broken (e.g. "Authoritas", "deferentis", "Moriosum") and are read with some doubt. Item 10 is cut off at the line end.
